Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.vpn

Class VpnProfile

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.vpn.VpnProfile
public class VpnProfile extends Object
One VPN connection the app can bring up. A profile is either NetworkManager-managed (discovered from nmcli connection show, carrying a uuid and driven by nmcli connection up/down) or file-imported (an .ovpn or WireGuard .conf the user added, carrying a configPath and driven by openvpn / wg-quick). The backend field records which tool drives it so the panel builds the right command and never guesses.

A profile is a plain Jackson bean persisted by VpnStore. It stores no secret: an OpenVPN/WireGuard config file holds its own keys and stays where the user put it (only the path is remembered), and NetworkManager keeps its own credentials. Every setter normalises null to empty and trims.

    • isKillSwitch

      public boolean isKillSwitch()
      True when this profile is armed with a kill switch: if its tunnel drops unexpectedly the desktop's network clients are cut (via org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.NetworkCut) until the tunnel is back, so traffic can never silently fall back to the clearnet. Defaults to false, so a profiles.json written before this field existed deserialises safely with the kill switch off.
      Returns:
      true when an unexpected drop of this profile should cut the network
